vairāgyaśāntyādisādhanāni varṇayiṣyanprastutāṃ jīvanmukti sthitimeva varṇayati
- etāmiti

yataḥ śubhāśubhamupādātuṃ hātuṃ vā na vāñchanti ata eva tatsādhanāni na
yācante

sacakṣuracakṣuriva sakarṇo'karṇa
iva samanā amanā iva ityādiśruteriti bhāvaḥ
īhā icchā ceṣṭā ca madhuravṛttiḥ śāntirbrahmākāratā ca

candrabimbe sthitaṃ svargiṇamiva manaḥ kartṛ candrabimbe
sthitamivetyutprekṣā vā

avajñātā upekṣitā mahāntaḥ pūjyā
janāstattvajñā yaiḥ
duradhigamāni śāstrāṇi kathaṃ maurkhyanivṛttiḥ syāttatrāha - kiṃciditi

vākyārthaḥ paramātmā bandhuḥ priyatamo'vaśyaṃ
labdhumiṣṭo yasya tena

moho mūrcchā mṛtyudvāraṃ tallakṣaṇe'pi tamasi nāndhatāmeti
kimanyatretyarthaḥ
nanu tṛṣṇātyāge upāyaṃ na paśyāmastatrāha - tāvaditi

tadātmatattvaṃ padyate prāpyate yena tajjñānaṃ tatpadaṃ
paramapuruṣārthasiddhaye sādhanīyam
na vidyate uttamamutkṛṣṭatamamanyadyasmāttathāvidhaṃ padaṃ vastu tadālambi

sa hi kūpastho na bahiḥ paśyati tatrāpyandhaścetsutarāmiti
bhāvaḥ
śaṭheṣu vaccakeṣu duranteṣu durucchedeṣu prabaleṣviti yāvat

ityādivākyaiḥ sukhaduḥkhadaśayoḥ
parasparavināśokterayaṃ kadāpi śreyasi tiṣṭhatīti śreyaḥstho viśrāntibhāṅga
bhavati

viṣavanmūrcchanena samucchraveṇa saṃmohaṃ kaśmalaṃ dātuṃ śīlaṃ yāsāṃ
tāsu saṃsārākhyamāyāsu midhyāvañcanopāyeṣu

nanu saṃsārātparamanyannāstyeva tatra kimavalambya saṃsāre kṣarati
kāryesyāśaṃkyāha - yaditi

iti śrutiśca asanneva sa
bhavati asadbrahmeti veda cet
asti brahmeti cedveda santamenaṃ tato viduḥ iti

yadi na syāttadā kiṃ syādyai
syānnāstiko hataḥ
iti nyāyena saṃdihānaṃ pratyapyāha - nāsti cediti

tarhi kathaṃ na sarve pravartanta ityāśaṅkya yāvannānugrahaḥ sākṣājjāyate
parameśituḥ

iti
vacanādīśvarānugrahalabhyamokṣabhāgitāśālina iva mokṣasādhane pravṛttirna
sarveṣāmityāha - pravṛttiriti

nanu dehendriyaviṣayaśūnyakevalībhāvahetunā kimanena śāstreṇa satsveva
dehādiṣūpāyāntareṇāpi svargādisukhasya saṃbhavādityāśaṅkyāha -
anapāyīti

svargādi apāyapatanāśaṅkā'svāsthyādigrastameveti kevalībhāva eva
puruṣārtha iti bhāvaḥ

tasyāḥ prāptau
satyāmuttamasya kaivalyasya prāptau kleśo nopajāyate

nanu dhanādibhireva
kevalībhāvo'stu kiṃ vicāreṇa tatrāha - neti

vicāraśca
śravaṇamanananididhyāsanairasaṃbhāvanādinirāsaḥ ekānta aikāgryaṃ ca
tābhyāṃ niścetuṃ śakyam

saṃsāre sāratvena prasiddhasukhānāmutkarṣe itareṣāmasārāṇāṃ sattasphūrtyoḥ
sīmāntaṃ paramāvadhim

etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrāmupajīvanti sā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ
ityādiśruteriti bhāvaḥ

vikāsī śamaḥ puṣpaṃ yasya uccasyotkṛṣṭasya taroḥ kalpavṛkṣasya phalaṃ
paraṃ sukham
sati manasi kathaṃ na vāñchā syāttatrāha - mana iti

saivādhvagasya tṛṣātāpasamā doṣadaśā tayā dīrghā
duratikramā śītalatāmeti śamenetyapakṛṣyate

hi yasmācchamena śreya āsādyate ata
āyurghṛtamitivadamedopacārāttatparamaṃ padaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti
śrutiprasiddhaṃ

evaṃ na sanna
cāsañchiva eva kevalaḥ iti śrutiprasiddhaḥ śivo'pi śama eva

evaṃ tarati
śokamātmavit ityādiśrutisiddhā sarvaduḥkhopaśāntirapi śama evetyarthaḥ

pāṭhāntare tu saundaryeṇa guṇairvijitāni vaśīkṛtāni
pareṣāmapi cakṣurmanaḥ prabhṛtīnīndriyāṇi yaiḥ

janitaṃ
kautukaṃ svātmānubhavacamatkāro yasmiṃstathābhūtaṃ sadyathā
prasādamadhigacchatīti saṃbandhaḥ
svādu madhuraṃ yathā syāttathā tatra tat mānase'tisvadate rocate
bhāvisukhādi na kāṅkṣati prārabdhaprāpitaṃ ca nojjhati
bhāveṣu viṣayeṣu vyavahārī sannapi na majjati nāsajjate

tucche mithyābhūte naśvare dehādau yasyāhamiti mano
nāsti
paramākāśena brahmaṇā sadṛśī samarasā prasiddhākāśavadavikāryā vā
loke'pi sarvagunaśraiṣṭhyena śamaḥ prasiddha ityāha - tapasviṣviti
